Hi Marissa,

Thanks for a great product — we've been using Redwood for embeddings and generation across a couple of internal teams. We're now evaluating the observability add-ons (longer retention for traces/metrics, advanced dashboards and tracing exports) for a cross-team rollout at Apex Analytics. Before a pilot, procurement asked for a clear pricing / packaging layout and what concessions or credits might be possible for a multi-region pilot (US + EU) and a 12‑month commitment.

Key asks:
- Pricing for 6mo and 12mo retention tiers (per GB/month equivalent)
- Tracing: full-span retention vs sampled retention pricing; any per-span or per-million-span metric
- Advanced dashboards: seat vs capacity / per-project pricing options
- Bulk discount guidance for anticipated ingestion of ~4TB/month during pilot
- Any trial credits or pilot programs (we're looking for a small POC to start)

Attached is a short requirements doc (Apex-OBS-requirements.pdf) with traffic estimates. Could we get a ballpark and, if possible, a one-page commercial that I can share with procurement? Also open to a quick call — available Thu/Fri this week.

Best,

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear requirements and the doc. Happy to put together a concise commercial for procurement and propose a pilot structure. Quick summary (ballpark) while I pull numbers and loop in pricing: 

- Retention: we typically offer tiered slabs (30 / 90 / 365 days). For volumes like yours the 90 -> 365 jump is ~2.6x per GB/day; we can explore a blended slab for the pilot.
- Tracing: two pricing modes — sampled retention (lower cost, adjustable sampling) or full-span retention (higher cost, billed per-million spans).
- Dashboards: seat-based for edit access + project capacity for heavy dashboards; we can show seat-lite for stakeholders.

Pilot concessions we can propose initially: up to $25k in pilot credits (applied to observability add-ons) and a one-month extended trial on 365-day retention for a single critical project. If you commit to a 12mo uplift from pilot, we can discuss a tiered discount in year 1.

I can do a 30-minute call Thu 10/09 or Fri 11/09 (PST). Which works for you? I'll also attach a short draft pricing spreadsheet for transparency — see attached.

Hi Samantha — thanks for waiting while we scoped this internally. Below is a concise pilot commercial and packaging that reflects internal alignment. I've also attached a short SOW template and the pricing workbook for procurement to review.

Pilot commercial (concise):
- Pilot length: 60 days, single critical project on 365-day retention; additional projects on 90-day retention.
- Pilot credits: $25,000 applied to observability add-on usage (retention + tracing credits).
- Retention pricing approach: blended slab for pilot to smooth pricing between 90d and 365d (applies to pilot only).
- Tracing: sampled retention at 40% sample by default; option to store full spans for a subset of services (billed at $X per million spans).
- Dashboards: 5 editor seats + unlimited viewer seats included for pilot. Production pricing can move to seat + capacity model.
- Year‑1 conversion: if Apex converts to 12mo commitment within 30 days of pilot end, Redwood will provide an 18% discount on add-on list pricing for year 1, plus a one-time migration credit equal to 30% of pilot overage credits (applied to first invoice).
